_note: EDIT THIS FILE FIRST. siteUrl must be your real domain before launch (used for SEO canonical tags, Open Graph and the sitemap). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored by the site build. Leave any url/handle empty ('') and the site shows a tasteful 'coming soon' state instead of a broken link.
tagline: Melodic dancehall & R&B — Jamaican roots, international sound.
bioShort: Sirius HIM is an independent melodic dancehall and R&B artist from Runaway Bay, Jamaica — carrying the rhythm of the north coast into a sound built for everywhere. Smooth melodies, honest bars, and a voice that moves between the islands and the world.
_note_contactEmail: Add your booking / general email, e.g. "bookings@siriushim.com". While it is empty the Connect page form explains that contact is not yet open instead of silently failing.
_note_ogImage: Placeholder. Before launch, replace src/public/og.svg with a 1200x628 PNG named og.png and set this to "/og.png".
_note_socials: Paste the full profile URL, e.g. "https://instagram.com/yourhandle". Empty url = the button shows 'coming soon' and does not link anywhere.
